customTerms.title: Protected terms
customTerms.description: Company-wide terms that trigger a warning, e.g. customer names, project code names.

allowSendAnyway.title: Allow users to send anyway
allowSendAnyway.description: If false, users can only replace detected data with placeholders or cancel.

forceEnabled.title: Always on
forceEnabled.description: If true, users cannot switch the protection off.

lockedCategories.title: Categories users cannot disable
lockedCategories.description: Any of: secrets, finance, personal, internal, labels, custom.
